note: Price entries superseded by a later reading. Appended, never rewritten (ADR 0023); moved out of the payload by ADR 0047 because no screen renders them. The current price stays on the dish in site/data/. These entries were read on 2015-09-29 from the shop's own boards, photographed in-store (intake/menus/KC cafe/, EXIF DateTimeOriginal 2015-09-29; ADR 0038, ADR 0107) — a wall board, a lit menu box numbered 1-30 and a side board. Each entry's note names the photograph it was read from and the wording the board used, because the menu was restructured between 2015 and the current reading and a name alone no longer identifies the line. Where a 2015 line could not be joined to exactly one dish that still ships, nothing was written: see docs/SESSIONS.md for what was read and not recorded. The current entries are a 2026-07-06 delivery-app reading and the 2015 ones are counter prices, so the two are not like for like — each entry states its own method (ADR 0031).
